Update: available → download → ready → restart

Before

After

Metadata checks leave the installation untouched. Downloads require Update now by default; an explicit preference can allow background downloads. Both policies stop at the verified-ready state until Restart and update is chosen.

Install and remove an engine

Version and channel choices use the retained kit Select, including search and long-list keyboard navigation. Repository, environment-variable and signing details are under Advanced. Disk checks happen before transfer; download verification, cancellation and retry use the service’s background jobs.

Removal inspection reads metadata only. It cannot uninstall, unregister or delete staging data. Cancelling or dismissing it preserves the installation. The actual removal rechecks ownership and open-project pins before committing.

Windows setup

Fresh install, same-version replacement, cancellation, running-program refusal, registration failure and locked-folder rollback are exercised with isolated destinations and no system integration.

Project and export decision status

The shared ara_doc::AUTHORING_ROOT interface is checkpoint 6203eb1e. Importer dependency metadata is checkpoint c30374a6; explicit Host lock release is b225050c. Full layout, asset operations and shipping acceptance remain separate slices.

| D30 | **Project layout draft; export layout approved by Islam.** Projects keep `ara.project.json`, `AGENTS.md` and optional `.mcp.json` at the root. All authored files, including C# scripts, live under one lowercase authored root, freely organized by the user; its name is a single constant in the shared project contract (`game/` is provisional, pending Islam's naming decision). `@path#id` resolves relative to that root. Any folder named `editor` contains editor-only C# compiled separately. A small `<name>.module.json` manifest defines an optional module boundary in any authored folder; scripts outside a module join the default game module. Generated `.csproj` files, caches, per-user state and logs live in gitignored `.ara/`. Versioned project policy (input, physics, quality/look defaults and layers) lives under `settings/`, build/export presets under `settings/builds/`, and output under gitignored `builds/`. Templates create an empty root `packages/` for future plugins/packages; the asset browser excludes it until plugins exist (D22). Repository sample tests and evidence live outside game projects. `ara project migrate --dry-run` previews migration of legacy type folders, `content/` and `assets/` drafts, and `scripts/` into the authored root, preserving IDs and references. Shipped desktop builds contain a game-named launcher, one data directory and notices (a native `.app` on macOS); export reports, verification captures, logs and symbols stay outside the shipped folder. Distribution manifests remain store-agnostic (D22). Project layout awaits Islam's confirmation before merge. | 2026-10-27 |
